::: {#def-rss}
#### Residual sum of squares

For data $(x_1, y_1), \ldots, (x_n, y_n)$,
the **residual sum of squares** of a line
with intercept $\intcoef$ and slope $\coef{x}$ is

$$\text{RSS}(\intcoef, \coef{x}) \eqdef \sum_{i=1}^n (y_i - \intcoef - \coef{x} x_i)^2.$$

Each term is the square of a [residual](estimation.qmd#def-residual),
with the line's value $\intcoef + \coef{x} x_i$ as the fitted value.

:::
